answer: Because the willow audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the oasis bond on all of them and exposing each to the river slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 12 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 386 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
